title: hedyotis auricularia subsp. venosa
intro: Hedyotis auricularia subsp. venosa, commonly known as Red Flowering Ear, is a species of plant in the family Rubiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Flowering Ear include wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's potential health benefits, including its use in treating skin conditions and wounds.
